Beab.description: Hi there, this is Beab. I am currently in the development of a small twincities based internet radio station. The station is called Souvenir or Souvenir FM or Souvenir Radio. The goal of this station is to give a platform to the countless number of djs, artists and entertainers in the twincities. I think that having a small internet radio station thats based in the twin cities will help strengthen our muscial communities more. I absolutely dont anticipate this on becoming a big thing, but i would like to treat it as a legitimite radio station later in the year. So for the next 5 months, i will be hosting a stream on either tuesday nights or thursdays. I will be playing music or talking about music. Each of these sessions will be a kind of showcase of the webiste and are planned to be a stress test. I will be slowly rolling out features and update the ui. Cheers
